title: Typed compact-support paths and their normalized constant-tower corners
statement: Fix a prime l and a finite extension E of Q_l, with R=O_E and its uniformizer ideal I. Use the actual completed integral coefficient sheaves, strict system calculus, and the normalized constant scalar restrictions H and U [def-sf-constant-completed-reduction-transport, def-sf-integral-system-operations]. Use the existing typed integral/system Expression syntax and Realizations data [def-sf-integral-system-realization-data, def-sf-integral-system-expression-domain]. Define unary words to exclude tensor, and require quasi-compact compactification opens. SeparatedWord records separation at every scheme; IntegralDomain records finite-Tor constructibility of every intermediate completed object and compactification open prefix. Let q_W be rho inverse followed by U of the inverse recursive reduction comparison; define the corner to be L(q_W) after the actual completion unit. Define towerMap as U applied to the actual whole-system map. Define Path as the inductively generated relation of prescribed identity, pullback compositor, compactification exchange, factorization expansion and refinement pairs; close it under inverses of isomorphisms, composition retaining the intermediate domain and pull/proper/open/compact-support whiskering. Refinement uses the published normalized open-unit mate and its proper compositors [def-sf-integral-support-refinement-comparison]; inverses use inverseOrZero [def-sf-comparison-inverse-or-zero]. EquationLaws is the conjunction of invertible corners, their displayed path square, and cancellation for parallel paths with equal whole-tower maps. All constructions are the unchanged public definitions extracted from the parent module.
